pfps.help_body:
Find new profile pictures.

**Subcommands:**
`{prefix}pfp color` - Find a profile picture with the specified color.
`{prefix}pfp gender` - Find a profile picture with the specified gender.
`{prefix}pfp couple` - Find matching profile pictures with the specified genders.
pfps.upload_body:
Upload one or more profile pictures at once.

**Subcommands:**
`{prefix}pfp upload color <color>` - Upload one or more profile pictures with the specified color.
`{prefix}pfp upload gender` - Upload one or more profile pictures with the specified gender.
`{prefix}pfp upload couple` - Upload matching profile pictures with the specified genders.
